documents.title: dsh-vision-fallback
documents.text: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts. Author: 1HelloMan1. npm package: dsh-vision-fallback. Community repository: https://github.com/1HelloMan1/dsh-vision-fallback.

documents.title: dsh-vision#vision-route
documents.text: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter. Author: 314857493. npm package: dsh-vision-proxy-route. Community repository: https://github.com/314857493/dsh-vision/tree/main/packages/vision-route.

documents.title: dsh-vision#vision-tool
documents.text: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required. Author: 314857493. npm package: dsh-vision-free-eyes. Community repository: https://github.com/314857493/dsh-vision/tree/main/packages/vision-tool.

documents.title: dsh-vision
documents.text: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel. Author: 54xkeee. npm package: dsh-vision-web. Community repository: https://github.com/54xkeee/dsh-vision.

documents.title: dsh-youreyes
documents.text: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel. Author: 54xkeee. npm package: dsh-youreyes. Community repository: https://github.com/54xkeee/dsh-youreyes.

documents.title: dsh-image-conatiner
documents.text: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer. Author: aa2246740. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-image-conatiner.

documents.title: dsh-vision-bridge
documents.text: Adds image input and recognition through configured DSH providers or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Author: alaxrpg. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/alaxrpg/dsh-vision-bridge.

documents.title: dsh-pdf-reader
documents.text: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents. Author: AngelosZou. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-pdf-reader.

documents.title: dsh-vision-toolkit
documents.text: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per day; configurable to your own provider. Author: Anionex. npm package: @anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit. Community repository: https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit.

documents.title: dsh-client-vision#tool-vision
documents.text: Screen capture and external vision recognition: take_screenshot, list_windows, analyze_image and view_image tools with a configurable GPT vision channel (gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra), API key via the credentials service, and a settings card; view_image shows the screenshot in the Web UI while the model context keeps text only. Author: ankye. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/ankye/dsh-client-vision/tree/main/packages/tool-vision.

documents.title: dsh-image-generation#tool-image-generation
documents.text: Model-facing image-generation tool with a configurable channel and normalized image parameters. Author: ankye. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/ankye/dsh-image-generation/tree/main/packages/tool-image-generation.

documents.title: dsh-guide-dog
documents.text: MiniMax-powered multimodal plugin: real-time voice call mode (streaming conversation, floating dock UI), voice mode and mic voice input, plus image/video/music/speech generation and vision inspection tools. Author: AtropinolTT. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/AtropinolTT/dsh-guide-dog.

documents.title: dsh-highres-vision
documents.text: For the DeepSeek Harness native vision model deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, raises image admission limits to 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 images and adds a highres_read tool that tiles large images, then returns the whole image plus 800x800 tiles through the host read_image tool. Author: azwosile. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/azwosile/dsh-highres-vision.

documents.title: dseyesopen
documents.text: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything. Author: balue8246-maker. npm package: not listed. Community repository: https://github.com/balue8246-maker/dseyesopen.

documents.title: Assistant animation: idle
documents.text: State: idle. Trigger: assistant is closed and the page is visible. Duration: 2600ms. Playback: loop. Next state: idle. Motion: float-and-breathe. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.

documents.title: Assistant animation: greeting
documents.text: State: greeting. Trigger: assistant opens. Duration: 600ms. Playback: once. Next state: idle. Motion: pop-and-settle. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.

documents.title: Assistant animation: thinking
documents.text: State: thinking. Trigger: question submitted. Duration: 2400ms. Playback: loop. Next state: typing. Motion: scan-and-pulse. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.

documents.title: Assistant animation: typing
documents.text: State: typing. Trigger: answer generation is active. Duration: 1100ms. Playback: loop. Next state: complete|no-answer|error-offline. Motion: thinking-pulse. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.

documents.title: Assistant animation: complete
documents.text: State: complete. Trigger: grounded answer is available. Duration: 900ms. Playback: once. Next state: idle. Motion: success-bounce. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.

documents.title: Assistant animation: no-answer
documents.text: State: no-answer. Trigger: no supported TAC knowledge base evidence is found. Duration: 700ms. Playback: once. Next state: sales. Motion: question-nudge. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.

documents.title: Assistant animation: sales
documents.text: State: sales. Trigger: visitor chooses contact sales or high-intent handoff is detected. Duration: 700ms. Playback: once. Next state: idle. Motion: handoff-point. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.

documents.title: Assistant animation: error-offline
documents.text: State: error-offline. Trigger: network or assistant request fails. Duration: 4200ms. Playback: loop. Next state: thinking. Motion: low-power-pulse. Reduced motion uses a static image and short fade; loops are disabled.
